name: Omni channel playbook
source: Omni best-practice framework for US pharma omnichannel. Guidance, not brand data: the brand plan wins.

ladder.name: Aware
ladder.goal: Knows the unmet need and that the brand exists

ladder.name: Interested
ladder.goal: Believes the data applies to their patients
ladder.success: Engaged HCPs, time with key content

ladder.name: Adopt
ladder.goal: Routine choice for the right patients
ladder.success: Repeat prescriptions, share of new patients, persistence

lifecycle.name: Launch
lifecycle.focus: Build awareness and first experience fast: experts, congress, rep and the HCP site lead.

lifecycle.name: Growth
lifecycle.focus: Scale reach and frequency: digital and point-of-care carry the message between rep visits.

lifecycle.name: Mature
lifecycle.focus: Efficiency: remote and triggered channels keep loyal prescribers; patients stay on treatment.

lifecycle.name: Loss of exclusivity
lifecycle.focus: Protect the base at low cost: CRM, support services and email.

channels.name: Rep visit (face to face)
channels.use_when: Priority HCPs who need the story explained and objections handled in person.
channels.watch_out: Most expensive touch: reserve for high-value HCPs; reps use approved materials only.

channels.name: Remote rep / e-detail
channels.use_when: HCPs who restrict access or sit outside rep territories.
channels.watch_out: Same MLR-approved content as face to face; record consent to contact.

channels.name: Rep-triggered email
channels.use_when: Following up a conversation with the exact topic discussed.
channels.watch_out: Reps choose from approved templates and can't edit the text.

channels.name: Brand email (HQ)
channels.use_when: Keeping consented HCPs updated at scale between rep contacts.
channels.watch_out: Opt-in only; respect frequency caps across all channels.

channels.name: Webinars & speaker programs
channels.use_when: New data, complex cases or a new treatment approach that needs peer voices.
channels.watch_out: Speaker programs follow the PhRMA Code and fair-market-value rules.

channels.name: Congresses & medical meetings
channels.use_when: Data read-outs and meeting the experts who shape guidelines.
channels.watch_out: Keep promotional and medical (non-promotional) activities separate.

channels.name: HCP portals & endemic media
channels.use_when: Reaching HCPs where they already read clinical content (e.g. Medscape, Doximity).
channels.watch_out: Buy against your target list, not general audiences.

channels.name: Programmatic / NPI-targeted display
channels.use_when: Adding frequency against a target list between personal touches.
channels.watch_out: Ad carries fair balance or a clear link to it.

channels.name: EHR / point-of-care messaging
channels.use_when: Reminding HCPs at the moment of the treatment decision.
channels.cadence: Triggered by the relevant diagnosis or visit
channels.watch_out: Must not interfere with clinical decision support; vendor rules apply.

channels.name: HCP website & resources
channels.use_when: The home for data, dosing, access and support that every other channel points to.
channels.cadence: Always on; refresh with new data
channels.watch_out: Gate HCP-only content; keep ISI visible.

channels.name: Journals & print
channels.use_when: Launch credibility and specialties that still read print.
channels.watch_out: Full prescribing information or brief summary required.

channels.name: Medical science liaisons
channels.use_when: Scientific exchange with experts; answers to off-label questions.
channels.watch_out: Non-promotional: never used as a sales channel.

channels.name: TV & connected TV
channels.use_when: Large, diagnosed patient populations who need prompting to talk to their doctor.
channels.watch_out: Major statement of risks and adequate provision (FDA).

channels.name: Paid search
channels.use_when: Capturing people already looking for the condition or the brand.
channels.watch_out: Branded ads need fair balance via the landing page.

channels.name: Paid & organic social
channels.use_when: Awareness days, community and short educational content.
channels.watch_out: Comment moderation and adverse-event reporting process needed.

channels.name: Patient website
channels.use_when: Explaining the condition and treatment in plain words; the destination for patient media.
channels.watch_out: Plain language; ISI on every page.

channels.name: Patient CRM (email & SMS)
channels.use_when: Helping patients start and stay on treatment.
channels.watch_out: Documented opt-in; texts follow TCPA rules.

channels.name: Patient support & hub services
channels.use_when: Removing access, cost and onboarding barriers.

channels.name: Advocacy & community partnerships
channels.use_when: Rare and serious conditions where patient groups are the trusted voice.
channels.watch_out: Groups keep editorial independence; disclose funding.

orchestration.detail: Send a rep-triggered email within 48 hours of a call, on the topic discussed.
Reach priority HCPs on 2–3 channels within the same two weeks, with one message.
Set one monthly cap per HCP across every channel; pause after an opt-out or a no-see flag.

orchestration.rule: Next best action, not a calendar
orchestration.detail: Let engagement (opens, attendance, prescribing) decide the next channel and message.
Email and SMS only with documented opt-in; honour opt-outs fast (CAN-SPAM, TCPA).
Every promotional piece carries fair balance and MLR approval; nobody edits approved copy.

orchestration.rule: One story for HCPs and patients
orchestration.detail: Time patient media so the patient's question meets an HCP who has already heard the data.
Change one thing at a time and keep a hold-out group to measure real lift.

measurement.question: Did we reach the right people?
